BiblicalUsage: Naomi is the wife of Elimelech, who leaves Bethlehem for Moab and loses her husband and her two sons there. She is left with two daughters-in-law, and she sends them back, saying the LORD should deal kindly with them as they have dealt with the dead and with her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Naomi's kindness in her own grief is the hinge of the book: she sends Ruth away, and Ruth refuses to go.
